title: Hunts FH-020V: Release held Hunt claims and give the opt-in an authoring surface
detail: Requires FH-020U. Register migration 20270346053000 through the serial HYG-217 process (policy-only PR first), record pgTAP and exact-head workflow_dispatch db-tests, real API acceptance, the approved apply sequence and Frequency Community ledger parity. Add the authoring control for evidence_policy.hold_for_review on a mission placement (lib/studio entity, no raw JSON field).
